# MXPACKPRO

MXPACKPRO is the international website of Foshan Xumelo Technology Co., Ltd., a custom food packaging supplier based in Foshan, China.

## Core pages
- [Products](https://mxpackpro.com/products): 51 custom packaging formats with product-specific fit checks and quotation links; original gift-box design visualizations are identified separately from product photographs
- [Custom packaging](https://mxpackpro.com/custom-packaging): custom structure, printing and sampling process
- [Solutions](https://mxpackpro.com/solutions): packaging by food business type
- [Guides](https://mxpackpro.com/resources): packaging buying guides
- [About MXPACKPRO](https://mxpackpro.com/about-us): company and project support
- [FAQ](https://mxpackpro.com/faq): MOQ, artwork, materials, samples and production answers
- [Request a quote](https://mxpackpro.com/get-a-quote): contact and quotation request

## Purchasing information
- [Buying guide](https://mxpackpro.com/packaging-buying-guide): product fit, sampling and delivery planning
- [MOQ and pricing](https://mxpackpro.com/moq-pricing-guide): specification-dependent minimums and quotation scope
- [Materials and food safety](https://mxpackpro.com/materials-food-safety): conditions and documentation to verify before ordering
- Product photos show example artwork. Final material, size, print, compliance documentation, pricing and delivery are confirmed in the project quotation.
- This file is a navigation aid, not an indexing requirement or a guarantee of AI search inclusion.

## Custom gift-box design formats
These ten formats are made-to-brief design options, not stocked products or proof of completed production. Images are original design visualizations. MOQ, material, inserts, sample availability and schedule require project review; no fixed price, certification or transit rating is asserted.
- [Pyramid favor gift box](https://mxpackpro.com/products/custom-pyramid-favor-gift-box): small apex-closure favor format, not the tiered catering box
- [Cylinder paper tube gift box](https://mxpackpro.com/products/custom-cylinder-paper-tube-gift-box): round body and cap
- [Heart-shaped rigid gift box](https://mxpackpro.com/products/custom-heart-shaped-rigid-gift-box): curved rigid base and lift-off lid
- [Hexagonal rigid gift box](https://mxpackpro.com/products/custom-hexagonal-rigid-gift-box): rigid shell, not the folding snack carton
- [Double-door drawer advent calendar box](https://mxpackpro.com/products/custom-double-door-drawer-advent-calendar-box): rigid drawer cabinet, not a perforated folding carton
- [Wine bottle gift box with insert](https://mxpackpro.com/products/custom-wine-bottle-gift-box-with-insert): bottle-specific fit and retention review
- [Medal and coin presentation box](https://mxpackpro.com/products/custom-medal-coin-presentation-box): recessed presentation insert; contents not included
- [Window-lid rigid gift box](https://mxpackpro.com/products/custom-window-lid-rigid-gift-box): framed transparent panel and rigid shell
- [Lid-and-base rigid gift box](https://mxpackpro.com/products/custom-lid-and-base-rigid-gift-box): separate two-piece lift-off construction
- [Shoulder-and-neck rigid gift box](https://mxpackpro.com/products/custom-shoulder-neck-rigid-gift-box): three-component raised-neck construction
